values.DataCenterNotes: The lateral delivers gas to the new Broadwing Energy plant in Decatur, Illinois, and to an Archer Daniels Midland facility, per a May 2025 federal notice. A Power Engineering report says Google will buy most of the Broadwing plant's power for its data centers, and ESG Today says the deal is meant to cover the energy needs of Google's growing data center footprint. No specific campus is named.

verifications.note: Federal notice for the Decatur Lateral says it delivers gas to Archer Daniels Midland and the Broadwing power facility.
Says Google will buy the majority of the Decatur, Illinois gas plant's power for its data centers.
Says the Broadwing deal addresses the energy needs of Google's data center footprint; plant on ADM site in Decatur.

records.researcher_notes: The Decatur lateral feeds the Broadwing plant. Google has agreed to buy most of that plant's power and says it is for its data centers. Two trade press sources say so. No single data center campus is named, and the pipeline filing itself does not mention data centers.
